nom: bareMinerals BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report positive results, including one with dry, reactive skin who found it worked well despite a strong white cast, and another who found it did not make her already-dry skin feel drier; several other reviewers recommend the dewy finish especially for dry skin.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying combination skin reports it does not cause irritation or clog her pores.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no irritation, breakouts, or reaction, describing the mineral formula as gentle and hydrating.
segments.oily: No reviewer identifies as having oily skin, but several caution that the very dewy, glowy finish can look shiny on oily skin and recommend setting it with powder.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the formula as hydrating, including reviewers with dry skin who say it did not leave them feeling drier; however, one reviewer found it dried out her face and another felt slightly dry partway through the day and needed a setting spray.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention sun exposure report no burning or redness on the face, including one who used it during a full beach vacation without burning.
concerns.barrier: The large majority of reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no irritation or reaction and call the mineral formula gentle; one reviewer, however, found the product consistently migrated into her eyes and caused burning, and returned it.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who comment on breakouts, including one with combination skin, report the formula does not clog pores or cause new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the finish as lightweight and not greasy despite being marketed as dewy; however, several, including some who found it too shiny or who advise against it for oily skin, report the dewy finish can read as greasy or needs setting powder to control shine.

aspects.libelle: Blends in with virtually no white cast
Runny, watery texture that's easy to over-dispense
Limited shade range for a tinted formula
Layers smoothly under makeup without pilling
Pricey for the amount of product
Bottle must be shaken well before each use

extraits.texte: I really wanted this product however, every time I wore it, do we get in my eyes and burn. Not ideal. I wilp be returning.

Unfortunately, this product was a miss for me. It has good coverage and tint but it smells disgusting and dries out my face. It was also too watery and did not hold its shape well before application. Overall, I would not purchase this.

extraits.titre: Dewy Protection Without The Heavy Feel
extraits.texte: This is a good choice for mornings when I want a no-makeup look that still offers a bit of color to help warm up my skintone. The finish is very sheer and provides just enough tint to even out my complexion without looking like a traditional base. The texture is so lightweight that the focus is clearly on the skin's texture and protection rather than coverage. It's the perfect balance for someone who wants to look polished but natural. ​You have to shake the bottle well before use. It actually sounds a bit like a paint can when you're mixing it up. I've found that the best way to apply it is with a buffing foundation brush. Using a brush allows for a quick, even wash of color and ensures the SPF is distributed properly. On days when I'm wearing a different base, I still dab this over my hyperpigmented areas for that extra layer of mineral protection. ​It's been great for my combination skin because it doesn't cause irritation or clog my pores. One thing to note is that it really does have a high level of dewyness. Since I tend to get shiny toward the end of the day, I've found it's best to use a light dusting of powder or keep some blotting papers handy so the glow doesn't become too intense. Overall it's a great product.

extraits.titre: Good everyday sunscreen, sensitive skin friendly!
extraits.texte: I've been using this sunscreen for a few weeks now and it fits really well into my daily routine. One thing I really like is that it actually matches my deeper skin tone without leaving a white cast, which is hard to find with mineral sunscreens. It feels lightweight on my skin and blends in easily, giving me a nice natural glow without looking greasy. I use it every morning after moisturizing, and it sits well on my skin and under makeup. I also haven't had any irritation or breakouts while using it and I have sensitive skin. The only downside for me is that I feel like I have to keep reapplying it more often than I'd like, especially in the heat. I know reapplying is important with any sunscreen, but I do wish it lasted a bit longer. Overall, it's still a really good everyday SPF and I'll continue using it.

Thank you bareMinerals for sending me the Sheer Medium BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 for free in order to review it! I really do love this product, the color may have been a little dark for me, but it will be great with a tan! It does not feel greasy, it doesn't get oily through the day. I love how I don't have to do multiple steps in the morning since this has the little bit of coverage and the sunscreen! Overall, it feels nice when applied. I have dry skin, I did not feel like this made my face feel even more dry, which is definitely a plus!

I suffer from dry skin and have skin that can be reactive to chemical forward sunscreens. I have greatly benefited from this sunscreen and find myself gravitating towards it when I'm trying a low-key routine. The white cast is very present but I am so happy with the formulation as it does not pill under my foundation. I'm looking forward to purchasing the tinted version!

extraits.titre: Glowy everyday SPF with a natural tint.
extraits.texte: I've been using this as my everyday SPF and it's honestly one of those "skin but better" products. It feels super lightweight, almost like skincare & blends in really easily without that heavy sunscreen feel. The tint is very sheer, so don't expect coverage like foundation, but it does help even things out just enough to make your skin look smoother and more put together. The finish is definitely dewy (like healthy glow, not oily), which I personally love. Only thing! if you have oily skin, you'll probably want to set it with powder because it can get shiny throughout the day.
